skill.summary: 整理QQ输入法公开官网、下载页、帮助中心与功能说明的版本入口、权限说明与常见问题信息。

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the qq-input-method skill.

- Registers the “QQ 输入法” skill for organizing information from the official QQ Input Method website.
- Focuses on collating publicly available pages: homepage, download, features, help, FAQ, and policy info.
- Specifies supported tasks, including platform/version listings, feature summaries, FAQ/help aggregation, and update logs.
- Clearly outlines boundaries: does not handle device control, private packages, system hacks, or sensitive data.
- Emphasizes compliance—organizes only public information and respects platform and privacy requirements.
